name: SafeDelete
description: Blocks deleting nodes that are linked from other entities' body fields to prevent broken links.
project_description:
Safe Delete 
 
 New in 1.0.74 - Vastly improved verification status messages, also added a new optional submodule which provides a report of menu links that link to archived (or other configurable moderation state) nodes of a configurable bundle type for a menu or several menus that are selected in the module settings. 
 New in 1.0.46 , add optional publishing verification that ensures linkit is used for anchors, prevents publishing unless anchor is a reference. 
 New in 1.0.29 , support verification of bulk delete when used with the latest release of moderated_content_bulk_publish and allow permission to override safe delete and show the delete button for files based on a permission that may be configured. 
 This module is built to prevent content atrophy by providing meaningful information about content usage and referenced content. 
 This module was originally designed to do validation to prevent deleting content that has referenced links created by linkit. 
 New in 1.0.5 now also supporting Managed Files usage verifications. 
 New in 1.0.1 now also supporting media entities and validates for usage of ckeditor body field embedded media entities. 
 New in 1.0.2 configurable definitions of 'orphaned' content and provide an orphan list page. 
 More helpful functionality will follow such as (friendly url and node/123 reference checks to be combined with the other results). 
 
 Features 
 
 Admin can limit the number of records to show on node delete form. 
 Validation on presave and on node delete confirmation page (safe delete) and validation on node save for archived moderation (safe archive) 
 More configuration options to follow 
 
 OPTIMAL USAGE: 
 Recommend using this module with Drupal core >=10.4.8, >= 11.1.8
